notFound.title: This page hasn't been drawn yet.
notFound.description: The address you're looking for may have moved, or never existed.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.description: An unexpected error occurred. Try reloading the page.

contact.title: Tell us about your project.
contact.intro: Four short steps, about two minutes. We read every request and get back to you on the channel you prefer.
contact.metaDescription: Describe your project in four short steps: needs, scope, details and contact. MGB Software will read your request and get back to you.

services.title: What should we build?
services.hint: You can pick more than one.
services.unsure: Not sure yet — let's figure it out together

scope.title: Scope
scope.hint: It doesn't need to be exact; it helps us start in the right place.

details.title: Tell us more
details.label: About the project
details.hint: Who is it for? What problem does it solve? Any sites or apps you'd like us to look at?

consent.label: I give my explicit consent for my personal data to be transferred via an email service located outside Türkiye so that my request can be answered.
consent.notice: Details are in the Data Protection Notice.
consent.alternative: If you'd rather not consent, you can write to us directly at {email}.

errors.too-long: You can write up to {max} characters.
errors.services: Pick a service or tick “Not sure yet”.
errors.consent: Consent is required to send the form.

sent.title: Thank you — your request reached us.
sent.body: We'll read it and get back to you at {email}.
sent.meetingBody: Pick a time that suits you and book a 30-minute intro call.
sent.meetingOpen: Open the calendar in a new tab

failed.title: Your request couldn't be sent right now.
failed.body: Nothing you wrote is lost. You can open a ready-made email with the same content, or try again in a moment.
failed.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again in a few minutes, or send it by email.

aside.title: WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

read.title: We read your request
read.body: We review the need, the scope and any examples you shared.

reply.title: We get back to you
reply.body: On the channel you chose — with questions, if anything needs clarifying.

meeting.title: Intro call
meeting.body: If you like, we talk through the details in a 30-minute call.

proposal.title: Written proposal
proposal.body: We send scope, timeline and budget in writing, so everything is on record.

aside.filesBody: You can send attachments directly to:

kvkk.metaDescription: MGB Software's notice on personal data processed through its website and project request form, under Turkish Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

reach.body: A quick question, a collaboration idea or something that isn’t a project? No need for the form. Just write to us here.
reach.projectHint: For a new project · 4 steps · ~2 minutes
reach.whatsappDraft: Hi, I’m reaching out from the MGB Software website. I’d like to talk about a project.
